name: SciMLRigorBench v4.0.0
description: SciMLRigorBench v4.0.0 is a reproducible benchmark and assurance framework for evaluating SciMLRigor v1.5.2 across ten methodological failure families (R01-R10). It includes a preregistered 60-scenario paired benchmark, a bespoke scikit-learn procedural reference, paired statistical analysis, source-backed external-validation context, documented capability mapping, figures, and publication-ready reports. The benchmark supports claims of standardized breadth and comparable aggregate diagnostic performance, not universal superiority over specialized diagnostics.
